items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: after rehearsing with us a whole lot and playing a little round, Bruce the man was playing peck horn then.

ctx.x: I know he had the one bad eye.
Yeah, well, alright. Well, he would be in the club. So after rehearsing with us a whole lot and playing a little round, Bruce the man was playing peck horn then.
